content.title: Sharp estimates for incremental moments of inverse subordinators and approximation errors for time-changed stochastic differential equations
content.abstract: This paper establishes precise upper and lower bounds for the incremental moments of general inverse subordinators. Such processes are used as random time changes to model subdiffusive phenomena. The upper and lower bounds provide the foundation for a general framework for analyzing numerical approximation of time-changed stochastic differential equations on deterministic time grids. We derive an upper bound for the approximation error and further prove that the resulting order of convergence cannot be improved in general.
